findings: Unif-ParamOnly uses the same shared-token architecture as JDF and isolates conditional-edge training from full-time-square training
Surge real-audio MSS is 7.68 for JDF and 11.35 for Unif-ParamOnly but the comparison still bundles training support and objective
JDF and JDF-A remain essentially tied on off-manifold MSS 7.68 versus 7.69
the test pool mixes Freesound with a proprietary one-shot library and many samples contain silent tails
tau near 0.1 is selected from the reported inference sweep without a separately described locked tuning protocol
source_updates.limited_conclusion: The same-architecture control strengthens evidence for full-time-square training, but the real-audio marginal and tau setting remain unvalidated for production use.

source_updates.title: Audio synthesizer inversion in symmetric parameter spaces with approximately equivariant flow matching
findings: the study deliberately restricts its main task to on-manifold inversion to avoid the general-audio projection confound
it establishes the Param2Tok and permutation-symmetry lineage later used by synth-JDF
its Surge Full task includes 165 parameters and fixed Chorus Delay and Reverb II routing
it uses 100 RK4 steps while synth-JDF reports 20 Euler steps
same-author same-method lineage means it is not independent confirmation of the later off-manifold claim
source_updates.limited_conclusion: Use as foundational lineage and task-contract evidence, not as independent replication or a numerically comparable benchmark.

findings: ASO explicitly falls back to raw note magnitudes with mixture phase when all ownership weights are zero and therefore trades off perfect mixture consistency
NoteSep median SI-SDR is 7.39 dB versus 5.09 dB for NoteGrab Selective but target gain remains 0.83
editing resums stored estimates and does not subtract a target estimate from the input mixture
a two-second 16-query input needs 16 NoteGrab passes plus ASO and is reported at 454.7 plus 32.7 ms on an NVIDIA A10
selective HPSS uses max 30 or f0 minus 60 Hz as a study-specific high-pass rule
source_updates.limited_conclusion: Treat ASO as learned ownership reallocation rather than exact waveform mixture consistency and require raw sum-null, latency and low-frequency preservation tests.

findings: clips are grouped by exact source-label set and embeddings are averaged before source contributions are fit
repeated holdouts move combinations back to training as needed so every held-out source remains known during fitting
FSD50K CLAP CKA is 0.60 plus or minus 0.02 versus 0.21 permutation and 0.52 label-overlap
CHiME-Home CLAP CKA is 0.76 plus or minus 0.06 versus 0.73 permutation and 0.62 label-overlap
semantic labels are correlated and potentially incomplete and need not correspond to independent physical sources
source_updates.limited_conclusion: The method predicts means of unseen combinations of known semantic labels, not per-clip source separation, unseen-source discovery or mix control.

source_updates.title: Evaluating Compositional Structure in Audio Representations
findings: A-COAT tests additive transformation consistency and A-TRE reconstructibility from timbre pitch rate and amplitude attributes
the benchmark uses controlled 10-second 32-kHz synthetic scenes with one to four normalized DX7-like sources
a linear Downsample baseline achieves A-COAT 1.00 plus or minus 0.01 but A-TRE only 0.23 plus or minus 0.16
CLAP reaches A-COAT 0.39 plus or minus 0.20 and A-TRE 0.90 plus or minus 0.05
the authors leave natural-recording transfer and downstream relevance for future work
source_updates.limited_conclusion: Additive geometry and useful semantic factorization are distinct; this independent comparator is synthetic and does not validate natural-mix control.

findings: no public synth-JDF code weights environment or exact training manifest verified
the older synth-permutations repository does not reproduce JDF
repository remains a coming-soon README
paper artifact statement is not satisfied by the current public repository
source configs tests presets and dataset-generation scripts are present
prediction scripts resolve checkpoints from local W&B run directories
no packaged checkpoint manifest or hashes found
repository is for the foundational model not synth-JDF

knowledge_cards: A same-architecture conditional-edge control is stronger causal evidence than comparison with a differently conditioned encoder baseline.
Full-time-square JDF training is supported as a bundled objective and support change; the unpaired-real marginal is not.
A hyperparameter selected from a displayed test sweep must be reselected on validation and locked before held-out evaluation.
Synth-inversion metrics cannot be compared across papers when active parameters effects solver and data contracts differ.
Source-family silence-ratio and transient-versus-sustain strata are necessary for mixed off-manifold pools.
NoteSep ASO reduces ownership conflicts but explicitly does not guarantee perfect mixture consistency.
Stored-estimate editing reconstructs unchanged material and therefore requires an unedited-sum null.
Note-level inference cost scales with query count and can become material in dense arrangements.
The max 30 or f0 minus 60 Hz selective high-pass is a paper preprocessing rule not a production EQ preset.
CLAP reconstruction predicts mean embeddings of label combinations not individual clips or isolated physical sources.
Combination-disjoint evaluation with all sources known does not test unseen-source generalization.
A perfect linear A-COAT baseline shows that additive geometry and useful semantic decomposition are distinct properties.
